I answered Marcus in a thread on his #north-team message: the contact for the door 6 duplicate arrivals at Quarrendon Freight Lines is Thea Ramaswell.

I took that from Dana's #north-team post of Aug 20, 2025, which Marcus can see. She wrote that Thea had flagged duplicate arrivals on door 6 again on the morning shift. The same trailer showed up as two rows because the driver checked in at the kiosk and dispatch then added him by hand. I also told Marcus that Dana owns the account on our side. I left out the seat count and contract details because he didn't ask for them.

My summary for Dana's question also went into #north-team as a separate message (ts …0127), next to the thread reply.
